statement.notes: Extracted the three distinct line items that constitute the total 'Depreciation and amortization expense³' (€32,056 for 2024, €28,282 for 2023) as reported in the supplementary table. These items are: 1) Depreciation and amortization of, and impairment losses on, intangible assets, property, plant and equipment, and investment property; 2) Amortization of and impairment losses on capitalized development costs; and 3) Depreciation of and impairment losses on lease assets. The 'Impairment losses on equity investments¹' (€710 for 2024, €717 for 2023) is excluded as it pertains specifically to equity investments, not the amortization of the company's own assets. All values are in € millions. The '¹' and '³' refer to footnotes (net of impairment reversals).
